subject: Rapid POC playbook & priority mapping — next steps
messages:
From: jasmine.liu@redwood.ai
To: Elaine Roberts <elaine.roberts@brightbridge.com>
Cc: ben.carter@redwood.ai, karthik.iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 13 Nov 2026 15:08:00 -0800
Subject: Rapid POC playbook & priority mapping — next steps

Hi Elaine — thanks again for the time earlier. Short recap and proposed next steps so we stay aligned before we lock in a kickoff:

Key pain & goals (as we heard):
- High variance in customer-facing answers from current retrieval layer; need more consistent responses for support bots.
- Latency spikes during peak traffic; goal is 95th percentile < 600ms for live assist flows.
- Want measurable uplift in resolution rate (target: +12% within the pilot).

Suggested rapid POC playbook (2-3 week fast path):
1) Scope: 3 production intents (billing, setup, troubleshooting) + internal test set (200 prompts).
2) Metrics: p95 latency, token cost per request, automated resolution delta (A/B), and prompt-eval pass rate.
3) Owners: Elaine (BrightBridge PM) — business acceptance; Jasmine (Redwood) — technical lead; Ben (Redwood) — infra/ops; Karthik (Redwood) — evaluation & prompt tuning.
4) Access & data: short-lived API keys to a staging dataset; minimal sample of support transcripts (anonymized).
5) Success gates: 1) p95 latency < 600ms on staging load profile, 2) automated resolution +12% on eval prompt set, 3) no PII in accepted training artifacts.

Logistics: we can stand up a dedicated staging slot on our Dedicated pool for the pilot. I attached a lightweight playbook (poc-playbook-v1.xlsx) and an access checklist (access-requirements.md) — both are draft.

Proposed near-term timeline:
- Week 0 (this week): sign off on scope and provide sample transcripts + SSO contact.
- Week 1: infra setup, API keys, and baseline evaluation run.
- Week 2: prompt tuning & A/B; handoff for business acceptance.

Can you confirm the three intents and whether BrightBridge can provide the anonymized transcript sample by Tue 11/17? If that works, we’ll target a kickoff on Wed 11/18.

Thanks — happy to jump on a quick 20-min call if you prefer a live sync.

Best,
Jasmine Liu
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
jasmine.liu@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0123

Attachments: poc-playbook-v1.xlsx (excel, 2 sheets) — access-requirements.md (markdown)
From: Elaine Roberts <elaine.roberts@brightbridge.com>
To: jasmine.liu@redwood.ai
Cc: ben.carter@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 13 Nov 2026 18:02:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Rapid POC playbook & priority mapping — next steps

Thanks, Jasmine — this looks great and aligns with what we discussed. Quick answers: 

- Confirm 3 intents: billing, subscription changes, onboarding troubleshooting. Those map cleanly to our top support buckets.
- We can provide ~300 anonymized transcripts by end of day Tue 11/17 (legal is okay with the export after redaction).
- SSO/contact: forwarding to our infra lead (cc'd in a follow-up).

Question: on the dedicated staging slot — do we need to sign any contract addendum for Reserved capacity for a 2-week pilot? Also curious about token visibility for our auditors.

I'll confirm infra lead + legal contact in a separate thread. Kickoff Wed 11/18 works on our side.

Best,
Elaine Roberts
Head of Product, BrightBridge Analytics
elaine.roberts@brightbridge.com
From: ben.carter@redwood.ai
To: jasmine.liu@redwood.ai, karthik.iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: monica.patel@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 08:14:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Rapid POC playbook & priority mapping — ops prep

Folks — looping internal ops items before the Wed kickoff:

1) Reserved capacity: legal will need a short addendum for a temporary reserved slot. Monica — can you pull the standard 14-day pilot addendum? If we need a faster sign, I can route to contracts.

2) Token visibility: we can expose token-level telemetry via a read-only dashboard (no raw text), and provide an audit log export for legal. Karthik — can you confirm the exact fields we’ll include for auditors? I propose: timestamp, route, model-id, token-count, latency-ms, request-id. No input text.

3) Access: Elaine will provide sample transcripts; we need a project-level staging bucket and an SSO user in the BrightBridge IdP. Access checklist attached (access-requirements.md).

4) Owners & timelines: Jasmine to own prompt suite building; Karthik to run evals; Ben to own infra and rollout.

I attached a slightly updated poc-playbook-v1.xlsx (added an ops tab) and the mutual-action-plan.pdf stub.

Monica — can you draft the addendum and share by EOD Tue so we can get legal review on Wed morning?

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Senior Customer Reliability Engineer, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai
From: jasmine.liu@redwood.ai
To: Elaine Roberts <elaine.roberts@brightbridge.com>
Cc: ben.carter@redwood.ai, karthik.iyer@redwood.ai, monica.patel@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 09:23:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Rapid POC playbook & priority mapping — confirmed kickoff Wed 11/18

Thanks all — quick confirmation and final checklist prior to Wed's kickoff (11/18 @ 10:00 PT):

BrightBridge deliverables before kickoff (Tue 11/17 EOD):
- Anonymized transcripts (300) uploaded to staging S3 bucket (details in access-requirements.md)
- Infra contact + SSO admin for SAML setup (name + email)
- Confirmation on any redaction constraints from legal (what fields to strip)

Redwood deliverables before kickoff:
- Reserved staging slot provisioned, temporary API keys + read-only token telemetry dashboard (Ben)
- Initial prompt/eval skeleton and baseline run (Karthik)
- Mutual action plan + pilot addendum for signature (Monica)

Agenda for kickoff (20–30m):
- Introductions & roles (5m)
- Confirm data handoff & security guardrails (5m)
- Baseline evaluation results & initial prompt passes (8–10m)
- Fast follow actions & timeline (5m)

If you prefer a different time, please flag. Otherwise we’ll send a calendar invite and the short runbook (link to Drive in the related_links) plus the proto playbook attached.

See you Wed — excited to get started.

Best,
Jasmine
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
